messages:
Olivia: Anyone up for an in-office watch party for the finals this Sunday? projector + couch vibes?
Raj: I'm in. Need snacks tho — who wants to coordinate?
Sam: I'll grab chips + salsa :chip: and a speaker.
Pilar: I can do non‑alc drinks and a vegan snack option :seedling:.
kitchen-bot: Heads up — building fridge cleanout scheduled Sat 6pm, anything chilled should be labeled.
Olivia: Quick logistics: Conf B has a projector free at 6:30pm, thinking start at 7. Is that okay?
Raj: works for me. also — pizza or wings? (important)
Sam: Pizza. Always pizza. :pizza:
Pilar: Wings if there's a vegan-ish alternative? maybe a big salad + some plant wings.
Olivia: OK vote with emoji: :pizza: for pizza, :poultry_leg: for wings.
Raj: :poultry_leg: (wings)
Sam: :pizza: (pizza)
Pilar: :pizza: but will still bring vegan sides.
Olivia: I'll handle ordering. Can we do a small $5 fantasy pot for bragging rights? Loser buys coffee next week.
Raj: I'm in. Also lol my fantasy final is a dumpster fire, will accept alms.
Sam: I'm in too, last week won by 0.8 points because of a 62-yard field goal, will defend the crown.
Pilar: I vote we also do a silly 'snack bracket' — who brings best topping. low stakes, high glory.
Sam: tiny printable bracket sounds fun. I can make one and pin it in the thread.
Olivia: Snacks sign-up quick list (I'll order pizza based on majority):
```
- Pizza (s) - @Olivia (will confirm #s)
- Wings - Open (Raj will pick up if we need)
- Chips + Salsa - @Sam
- Drinks (non-alc) - @Pilar
- Vegan sides - @Pilar
- Speaker - @Sam
```
Raj: If I'm picking up wings I'll need someone to Venmo me. DM acceptable.
Sam: Venmo accepted. also projector cable is in the AV cabinet, ping me if you want me to bring extras.
Olivia: Calendar invite created for Conf B 6:30–10pm, I'll set event to allow guests — bring plus‑ones if you want.
Pilar: Awesome. RSVP emoji time: :thumbsup: if you're coming solo, :busts_in_silhouette: if bringing a guest.
Raj: :thumbsup:
Sam: :busts_in_silhouette:
Olivia: Alright final checks — do we need plates/utensils? snackbot, do we have disposable plates in kitchen inventory?
snackbot: Inventory check: disposable plates (30), napkins (50), plastic cutlery (40).
Olivia: Perfect. Anyone up for a tiny side bet: loser of fantasy final buys donuts for the team Monday?
Raj: On the record: loser buys donuts. I'm terrified.
Sam: I'll gladly lose if they're maple.
Pilar: I'll judge the best snack topping bracket.
Olivia: Great — I'll post the poll in #random after lunch and pin sign-ups here. See y'all Sunday :popcorn:
